text:
Ellen: During Zenith Health POC demo we hit a string of 429s on embeddings around 11:03 ET when they bulk-uploaded docs.
Ravi: Were they using concurrent batch calls or one big request?
Ellen: Frontend split into 6 parallel batches (~6k tokens each). Errors started after ~30s.
Chris: Any rate headers captured?
Ellen: Customer screenshot shows:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 119
Retry-After: 30
Request-ID: rwd-req-db12a
```
Nina: That limit aligns with tokens_per_minute for embeddings. 6*6k=36k tokens in-flight, so background traffic could push them over the 60k cap.
Ravi: Sales had told them 100k token/min for the trial, looks like tenant config is lower. Can we bump temporarily for the demo?
Chris: Short term options: 1) Temp override to 120k tokens/min, 2) Ask customer to drop parallelism to 2, 3) Client-side chunking.
Ellen: They want a quick fix so the demo continues. Sales prefers override.
Ravi: I'll apply a 8-hour override and record note for billing. Command: `redwood-admin quotas adjust --tenant zenith-health --route embeddings --tokens-per-minute 120000 --expires 8h --note "POC demo bump"`
ops-bot: quota-change: tenant=zenith-health route=embeddings old=60000 new=120000 by=Ravi expires_in=8h note="POC demo bump" request_id=rwd-admin-99f
Ravi: Done. Propagated to control plane; caches pick up within ~30s.
Ellen: They retried and uploads completed without 429s. Customer happy.
Nina: Postmortem items: add POC prep checklist item to verify per-route token caps, add SDK guidance to limit concurrency when utilization >70%, and surface current per-tenant caps in demo UI.
Chris: Filing INFRA-4927 to expose per-tenant token utilization in the demo console.
Ellen: Also advise the customer to schedule large imports outside of scheduled background jobs we observed in their logs.
Ravi: I'll attach the override approval to the deal record. Closing thread after infra ticket and sales note. :white_check_mark:
